name: Residence Permit for an Employed Person (TTOL)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a binding employment contract or job offer with a Finnish employer; the employer must submit the terms of employment confirming professional qualifications for the role.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Finnish employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Must earn at least EUR 1,600 per month (2026 threshold). Evening/night-work bonuses are excluded; up to 50% of income may consist of fringe benefits (company car, employer housing) at taxable value.
For some occupations, the employer must establish whether suitable labour is available within a reasonable time in Finland or the EU/EEA before hiring from outside.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract or binding job offer

outcome.duration_length: continuous (A) residence permit; first permit typically up to 1 year, extended permits up to 4 years

sources.title: Maahanmuuttovirasto -- Residence Permit for an Employed Person (TTOL): EUR 1,600/month 2026 minimum income, employment contract, labour market testing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Finland). pr_after_months (48) reflects the fastest of the 5 new permanent-residence paths effective 8 January 2026 (see fi_permanent_residence.json) -- specifically the EUR 40,000/year income path or the degree-based paths, all requiring only 4 years; the 6-year path with lower income requires a longer wait. work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the TTOL permit is typically tied to the sponsoring employer/occupation, standard for employer-sponsored permits in this dataset.
